row.name: Bank Of Montreal Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=23 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.66 tightness=1.14 base_volume_vs_leg=1.09 base_volume_vs_avg=1.08
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 23 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.66 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 2.2% vs its 20-SMA, 1.6% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The shaded base spans roughly 23 sessions and is visibly a wide, choppy consolidation that gave back two-thirds of the prior leg — the chart shows overlapping red and green bars ranging from ~167 to ~187, a clear downtrend within the box rather than a tight shelf. Both C and RE fail on the checklist, and the chart confirms both: the base is loose and deep, and the burst bar's 1% range is not the widest of the last five sessions. Together these two independent failures — a structurally broken consolidation and no range expansion — make the setup wrong, not merely imperfect.
claude.key_risk: The base gave back 66% of the prior leg and the stock is still trading well below the base high (~187), meaning any follow-through immediately faces the full weight of overhead supply from the entire consolidation range.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if price gaps above the entry ceiling or if the first 30 minutes show no ability to hold above the prior close of ~174.49, confirming the burst bar was a one-day event with no continuation.

row.summary: BMO: +1.6% on 4.2× volume out of a base 10.8% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
